cues.en: Welcome to this section of the course.
cues.zh: 歡迎來到課程的這一節。

cues.en: Multivariable calculus is really beautiful and will lead you to advanced topics in mathematics, including
cues.zh: 多變數微積分真的很美，會帶領你進入更進階的數學主題，包括

cues.en: differential geometry, multi dimensional optimization, and lots of other sophisticated applications.
cues.zh: 微分幾何、多維度最佳化，以及許多其他精密的應用。

cues.en: Now, multivariate calculus is a big topic.
cues.zh: 多變數微積分是個龐大主題。

cues.en: In fact, in many university curriculums, you wouldn't even learn multivariate calculus in the first semester or even in the first two semesters.
cues.zh: 事實上，在許多大學課程裡，第一學期，甚至前兩學期，都不會學到多變數微積分。

cues.en: It might only be in your third semester or even later, where you'd start to learn about calculus on functions with multiple variables.
cues.zh: 也許要到第三學期，甚至更晚，才開始學多變數函數的微積分。

cues.en: But the thing is, multivariate calculus is challenging because there's a lot to keep track of, but it's not really conceptually much different from single variable calculus.
cues.zh: 多變數微積分有挑戰性，是因為需要追蹤很多事情，但概念上，其實與單變數微積分沒有太大差異。

cues.en: And, you know, it's such a beautiful topic.
cues.zh: 而且，這個主題非常美。

cues.en: It creates these really beautiful graphs.
cues.zh: 能建立非常漂亮的圖形。

cues.en: So I wanted to include this section to give you an introduction to the topic fundamentally and also introduce you to a few applications.
cues.zh: 所以想加入這一節，介紹這個主題的基礎，也介紹幾種應用。

cues.en: I think the most important thing to keep in mind about multivariate differentiation is that it's basically the same thing as single variable calculus.
cues.zh: 關於多變數微分，最重要的是記住，它基本上與單變數微積分一樣。

cues.en: So all the foundational material, all the tricks and the rules and the tips that you've learned so far in this course are also going to apply here.
cues.zh: 這門課到目前為止，學過的所有基礎、技巧、規則與訣竅，在這裡都能使用。

cues.en: It's just that there's more stuff to keep track of, more variables.
cues.zh: 只是需要追蹤更多東西，更多變數。

cues.en: And basically, you treat the multiple variables within one function as if they were multiple functions, each with a single variable.
cues.zh: 基本上，把同一函數裡的多個變數，當成好幾個各自只有單一變數的函數來處理。

cues.en: So yeah, all of this means is that the same concepts, but there's more to keep track of.
cues.zh: 所以，概念一樣，只是要留意的事情更多。

cues.en: Now, in fairness, it is a little bit more confusing than this statement here, because sometimes you treat variables as constants and other times you treat them as variables.
cues.zh: 公平來說，其實比這句話稍微複雜，因為有時把變數當成常數，有時則當成變數。

cues.en: You'll learn about this over the next several videos.
cues.zh: 接下來幾支影片會學到。

cues.en: The last thing I want to mention before getting started is just a little bit about terminology.
cues.zh: 開始之前，最後想談一點術語。

cues.en: So you might hear or read the terms multivariable calculus or multivariate calculus or multidimensional calculus.
cues.zh: 你可能會聽到或讀到 multivariable calculus、multivariate calculus，或 multidimensional calculus。

cues.en: So what are these things and are they actually different from each other?
cues.zh: 這些分別是什麼？真的彼此不同嗎？

cues.en: Well, not really.
cues.zh: 其實不太是。

cues.en: Mostly these terms, especially multi variable and multivariate, are used interchangeably that you see even here on Wikipedia.
cues.zh: 大多數情況，這些詞可以互換，尤其是 multivariable 與 multivariate，這裡維基百科上也是這樣。

cues.en: Now, actually in the statistics literature, there is a subtle distinction between these terms, but this actually has nothing whatsoever to do with calculus.
cues.zh: 其實，統計學文獻裡，這些詞有細微差別，但那與微積分完全無關。

cues.en: These are just the same words used in a different mathematical field.
cues.zh: 只是相同詞彙，用在不同的數學領域。

cues.en: And honestly, even in statistics, people use these terms interchangeably.
cues.zh: 老實說，即使統計學裡，大家也常交替使用。

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: So the point is that you can use these terms interchangeably, and I certainly will.
cues.zh: 重點是，你可以交替使用這些詞，而我也一定會。

cues.en: So that's it for this intro.
cues.zh: 這段介紹就到這裡。

cues.en: Multivariate calculus is a beautiful topic because it creates beautiful graphs, beautiful images to ogle at.
cues.zh: 多變數微積分是個美麗的主題，能產生漂亮的圖形、讓人看得入迷的影像。

cues.en: And as always, I hope you enjoy working through this section and learning about multivariable calculus.
cues.zh: 一如往常，希望你喜歡這一節，享受多變數微積分的學習。
